name: IC 5201 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 5201, a barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ic5201-hubble
story: A spiral galaxy with a bar of stars slicing through its center, like two thirds of all the spirals we see, our own Milky Way included. Hubble can pick out individual stars in galaxies like this, and here it used them to help measure distances and map how nearby galaxies move.

claims.text: IC 5201 is a barred spiral galaxy
Like two thirds of all spirals, including the Milky Way, it has a bar of stars through its center
Hubble's ACS can resolve individual stars within other galaxies
IC 5201 is a target of Hubble program 13442, which measures distances to nearby galaxies to map the local velocity field
IC 5201 is confirmed as a barred spiral galaxy by NASA
